topic: Fundamentals of Vectors: The Language of Space
target_audience: High school students or beginners in STEM

sections.title: What is a Vector? (Intuitive Concept)
lecture_lines: Vectors act like arrows in space.
animations: Display scalar value 5.0 with label 's' in color #FFFFFF.
Show arrow representing vector v in color #FF00FF with label 'v'.
Draw both scalar s and vector v alongside. Color #FFFFFF and #FF00FF.

sections.title: Visualizing Vector Addition
lecture_lines: The resultant connects start to finish.
animations: Place two arrows labeled 'u' (#00FFFF) and 'v' (#FF00FF) tip-to-tail.
Draw the resultant arrow from start of u to end of v in #FFFF00 labeled 'u+v'.
Show vectors rearranged as 'v' then 'u' reaching the same endpoint in #FFFF00.

sections.title: The Components of a Vector
lecture_lines: Break vectors into x and y.
Use i and j basis units.
animations: Display vector v in #FFFFFF on a subtle grid. Label 'v'.
Decompose v into horizontal component in #FF0000 labeled 'vx'.
Decompose v into vertical component in #00FF00 labeled 'vy'.

sections.title: Scaling Vectors (Scalar Multiplication)
animations: Animate lengthening v by factor 2 in #00FF00. Label '2v'.
Animate reversing and shortening v by -0.5 in #FF0000. Label '-0.5v'.

sections.title: Summary & Real-World Application
animations: Display a collection of various vectors in #FFFFFF.
Highlight one vector in #FFFF00 performing a rotation. Label 'Rotation'.
Flash all vectors in #00FFFF simultaneously for summary. Label 'System'.
